mascot._comment: Mascot layer config, read by pipeline/orchestrate.mjs. `src` is relative to video/public/ and must point at an alpha WebM produced by tools/chromakey.mjs.
mascot._status: mas_chromo is a real green screen (key 0x1b9e35, saturation 0.83) and keys cleanly with chromakey + despill — no fur holes, no halo. It supersedes the white-background clips, which key badly; see docs/mascot-keying.md. Source is 1920x1080 24fps, so it upscales well but will judder if a 24->30 pulldown is visible.
